pr46.body:
Long Studies save independent Use Motes intent and exact repeat-speed targets. Each new level starts at 1x and pays the full selected existing price again; actual Luminous reward boundaries determine payment timing.

R2 fixes QA blocker B1: a Motes boundary exposed double kill rounding in existing farm batching. Damage is decomposed before consuming partial enemy HP, with one coherent quotient/remainder carry. This also preserves small current HP against cancellation at very large damage. Prices, reward rules, save schema, navigation, workflows and existing numeric tolerances remain unchanged.

Final local validation: all seven workflow gates exit 0; all 140 default scenarios execute, 160 raw real browser/driver results independently replay as complete PASS, and all 12 required negative controls are caught. The aggregate suite console file lacks its tail; complete subprocess outputs and exits are preserved. The permanent B1 ledger covers all 826 QA fixtures with zero unjustified ON/OFF economy differences, rechecks all 43 R1 counterexamples, and rejects the exact old double-round function before undo passes. Additional evidence includes 100 QA motor groups, five persistence paths, 576 exact-rational arithmetic fixtures and 56 scaled whole/split thresholds. Earlier local drafts and interrupted validation are diagnostic evidence, not acceptance.

Base: `1ddc246eb62782a61ec5c486cd5f51ea170bb338`. R2: `3cdebc236e9ee5081a4bca4e323b11f43aa0d46d`, tree `70073a55d7f5fe428ae82223627603498cc372b6`, parent R1 `d1e988816ed10b8f851521938a117a4d84d29e1b`. [B1 contract](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/blob/3cdebc236e9ee5081a4bca4e323b11f43aa0d46d/docs/tasks/LAB_MOTES_B1_001.md).

Ordinary same-head pre-merge CI #128 (run 37447570925, attempt 1) completed successfully on R2; all 13 job steps succeeded. Draft for new Core chronology/economy and independent QA review; R1 acceptance does not transfer. Physical Android/TalkBack remain untested. No ready, merge, Android build, dispatch/rerun or release.
